facts.fact_text: On 12 October 2013, an opposition group called İctimai Palata held a demonstration.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was intended to be peaceful.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was conducted in a peaceful manner.
The participants in the demonstration of 12 October 2013 were protesting against alleged irregularities and fraud during the presidential elections of 9 October 2013.
All three applicants participated in the demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013.
After the end of the demonstration of 12 October 2013, the applicants were arrested at the entrance to a nearby metro station called Inshaatchilar.
The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' custody are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).

The circumstances of the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' custody are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).

The circumstances of the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).
Law no. 135-IVQD of 31 May 2011 introduced amendments to the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 (CAO).
Law no. 135-IVQD of 31 May 2011 entered into force on 1 July 2011.

After the amendments introduced by Law no. 135-IVQD of 31 May 2011, Article 410.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that a copy of the administrative offence report shall be given to an individual who is subject to the administrative offence proceedings or to a representative of a legal entity.

After the amendments introduced by Law no. 135-IVQD of 31 May 2011, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an aggrieved person in administrative offence proceedings has the right to a copy of the administrative offence report.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was authorised by the Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA), the relevant authority.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was held in the Mahsul stadium, a place proposed by the Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA).
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was intended to be peaceful.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was conducted in a peaceful manner.

The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
